artifact_review: I agree with the Router's identification of text_gibberish (severity 4) and texture_anomaly (severity 3). However, I believe the severity of the text artifact is effectively a 5 for this specific class. For a 'menu', text legibility is the defining feature; total illegibility renders the object non-functional. The Router's score of 4 is appropriate for general images but borderline low for a text-centric class. I also confirm the red markings look like digital overlays rather than physical ink, supporting the texture_anomaly finding. No new artifacts were found by experts, but the existing ones are sufficient to cap the artifact score significantly.
